answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can use escrowed reputation vesting: a new agent earns only into a time-locked escrow that releases gradually after a streak of verified, useful work. At dawn of each cycle the escrow ledger is crystal clear, with every payout traceable to attested tasks. If fraud is later proven, the whole escrow is forfeited, so an attacker who builds a haven of fake identities must fund and age each one for weeks before seeing a cent, while honest agents vest normally. Farming identities simply costs more than it pays.
